reading.question: Who will inherit the land in this passage?
reading.explain: The heading and text say the daughters of Zelophehad will inherit the land.

reading.ru: Моисей сделал, как повелел ему Господь.
reading.question: What did Moses do?
reading.explain: The text says Moses did as the Lord commanded him.

reading.ru: Он поставил Иисуса перед священником Элиазаром и обществом, возложил на него руки и назначил его своим преемником, как говорил через Моисея Господь.
reading.question: Whom did Moses commission as his successor?
reading.explain: The text says Moses set Joshua before Eleazar and appointed him his successor.

reading.ru: Это были воды Миривы у Кадеша, что в пустыне Цин.
reading.question: Where were the waters of Meribah?
options: At Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin
reading.correct: At Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin
reading.explain: The text says they were the waters of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

reading.ru: Почему имя нашего отца должно быть забыто его кланом из-за того, что у него не было сыновей?
reading.question: What did the daughters not want to happen?
options: Their father's name to be lost
reading.correct: Their father's name to be lost
reading.explain: The daughters ask why their father's name should be lost from his clan because he had no sons.

reading.ru: Поднимись на эту гору в Нагорье Аварим и посмотри на землю, которую я даю израилетянам.
reading.question: What did the Lord tell Moses to do?
options: Go up the mountain and see the land
reading.correct: Go up the mountain and see the land
reading.explain: The Lord tells Moses to go up the mountain and see the land given to Israel.
